newsitem.title: USA: Thinking Tools shr offer priced at $6.50.
newsitem.headline: Thinking Tools shr offer priced at $6.50.

text.p: Thinking Tools Inc said Thursday that its filing for a public offering of 1.4 million shares of common stock has been declared effective by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and that the shares have been priced at $6.50 a share.
The company said it has granted the underwriter, Barington Capital Group LP, an option to purchase up to 210,000 shares to cover over-allotments.

Net proceeds from the offering will be used to fund the company's sales and marketing, and product development efforts, to fund the retirement of Bridge Notes, and for working capital and general corporate purposes.
After the offer, there will be about 4,430,000 shares outstanding.
Thinking Tools, headquartered in Monterey, California, develops PC-based business simulation software programs.
